# ToolsWaala Extended Documentation (llms-full.txt)

Website: https://toolswaala.in
Publisher: ToolsWaala
Location: New Delhi, India
Target Region: India (en-IN)
Monetization: 100% Free for users (Optional Pro tier for heavy batch operations)

---

## Technical Architecture & Privacy Standard
ToolsWaala is built on Astro 7 static architecture with client-side React 19 hydration. Unlike conventional online tool websites that upload user documents to remote server clusters, ToolsWaala executes 100% of data manipulation, PDF rendering, image processing, and financial calculations directly inside the user's browser (WebAssembly, PDF.js, Canvas API).

- Zero Server Uploads: PDF files, images, and financial details never leave the user's client device.
- Zero Signups Required: Users can access all 38+ tools without entering an email address or password.
- Offline Capability: Tools stay functional after initial asset download.

---

## Detailed Tool Reference

### 1. Academic & University Grading Tools
- CGPA to Percentage Converters: Supports official formulas for 16+ universities:
  - Mumbai University: Percentage = (7.1 × CGPA) + 11
  - VTU (Karnataka): Percentage = (CGPA - 0.75) × 10
  - Anna University: Percentage = CGPA × 10
  - AKTU / UPTU: Percentage = (CGPA - 0.75) × 10
  - KTU (Kerala): Percentage = (CGPA × 10) - 3.75
  - SPPU (Pune): Percentage = (CGPA - 0.75) × 10
  - Delhi University (DU): Percentage = CGPA × 9.5
  - CBSE Board: Percentage = CGPA × 9.5
  - JNTU Hyderabad (JNTUH): Percentage = (CGPA - 0.5) × 10
  - GTU (Gujarat): Percentage = (CPI - 0.5) × 10
  - Calicut University: Percentage = CGPA × 10
  - JNTU Kakinada (JNTUK): Percentage = (CGPA - 0.75) × 10
  - Osmania University: Percentage = (CGPA - 0.5) × 10
  - RGPV Bhopal: Percentage = CGPA × 10
  - BPUT Odisha: Percentage = (CGPA - 0.5) × 10
  - SRMIST: Percentage = CGPA × 10

- Attendance & Bunk Calculator:
  - Input: Total conducted classes, attended classes, target percentage (default 75%).
  - Output: Maximum safe bunks available OR exact number of consecutive classes required to reach 75%.

### 2. Business, Tax & Billing Tools
- GST Invoice Generator:
  - Custom line items with CGST, SGST, IGST calculations.
  - HSN/SAC code lookup directory.
  - Instant client-side PDF invoice generation.
- UPI Payment Link & QR Code Generator:
  - Formats standard UPI URI (`upi://pay?pa=...&pn=...&am=...`).
  - Generates scannable QR codes compatible with PhonePe, Google Pay, Paytm, and BHIM.
- Income Tax Calculator (FY 2025-26):
  - Side-by-side comparison of tax liability under Old Tax Regime vs New Tax Regime.
  - Includes standard deduction (₹75,000 for FY 2025-26) and Section 87A rebate calculations.

### 3. Client-Side PDF Utilities
- PDF Compressor: Reduces file size via canvas canvas downsampling and stream optimization inside browser memory.
- Image to PDF: Converts multi-format images (JPG, PNG, WebP) into single or multi-page PDF documents.
- Merge & Split PDF: Re-orders, splits, or combines PDF page streams locally.
